newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian bourse registers more operators.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian bourse registers more operators.

text.p: The number of capital market operators in Nigeria rose to 193 by end-November 1996 from 165 in September 1996, the securities and exchange commission, which registers all market participants, said on Tuesday.
"The increase is due to the growing awareness of the market," the commission said in a statement.
It did not give the figure for the preceding year.
The commission said the number was set to increase in the next few months as prospective operators were still seeking registration.
Among the operators registered are brokers, issuing houses, investment advisers, portfolio managers and others.
